summary: A small-shop owner says a living wage is right but the raise is hard to carry.
realLife: A restaurant owner in a city with wage tiers by business size said he agreed with a living wage in principle, then listed the raise, health coverage for staff over twenty hours and his own profit as pressures. He expected to hold staffing down, keep kitchen raises small because tipped staff already earned well, and perhaps raise menu prices.
sources: KSTP (St. Paul, Minnesota), 'St. Paul's new minimum wage for small businesses is helping workers, posing challenges for owners', July 2025: https://kstp.com/kstp-news/top-news/st-pauls-new-minimum-wage-for-small-businesses-is-helping-workers-not-so-much-owners/
